operator_assessment.operator_summary: The season plan is usable and hard-valid (deterministic verification passes with zero violations). This export reflects a targeted operator-driven banned-date repair: five global dates (2026-10-23/24/25, 2027-02-27/28) were recorded as canonically unavailable and the 23 tournaments that had been scheduled on them were repaired in one atomic batch -- 20 moved (host and roster preserved on every one, only date/arena/start_time changed) and 3 cancelled as a genuine last resort after exhaustive verified search found no legal relocation. Pre-existing, season-wide soft-quality findings (participation shortfalls, temporal clustering, hosting balance, unplaced placements) remain open from before this repair and were deliberately not auto-repaired, per the narrow scope of this operator request; a modest increase in several of these counts is a real, documented consequence of the repair (fewer available slots after removing five dates) rather than a new defect.

key_tradeoffs.title: 3 tournaments cancelled instead of relocated
key_tradeoffs.summary: rvv-0027 (Frisk Asker U11) and rvv-0163 (Frisk Asker U12) were cancelled because Askerhallen (Frisk Asker's only arena) has exactly one verified legal opening across the whole searched window (2026-10-17 to 2027-03-21) -- 2027-03-06 ~12:00-14:35 -- and three displaced Frisk Asker tournaments (rvv-0027, rvv-0142, rvv-0163) competed for it; only rvv-0142 could be placed there. rvv-0186 (Jar U11) was cancelled because the only verified legal Jar Isforum date, 2027-03-06, was already required by rvv-0165, with which it genuinely shares two rosters (Jar Rod U11, Frisk Asker 2 U11). This is arena-capacity and roster-identity scarcity, not a search shortcut: 250+ individual trials for the Askerhallen tournaments and 294 for the Jar Isforum pair found no alternative for the cancelled party in either case. Note: an earlier draft incorrectly attributed rvv-0163's conflict to a shared 'Jar Bla' team with rvv-0142 -- those are different rosters (different age groups); the corrected, verified cause is pure Askerhallen arena-capacity scarcity, not roster duplication.

key_tradeoffs.title: Modest increase in pre-existing soft-quality findings
key_tradeoffs.summary: participation_deviation findings rose from 195 to 209, temporal_clustering from 73 to 81, and hosting_balance_imbalance from 4 to 5 as a direct, expected consequence of relocating 20 tournaments off banned dates and cancelling 3 with no participation/hosting remapping. These were not auto-repaired, per the operator's explicit instruction to keep this repair scoped to the banned-date violations only.

remaining_actions.title: Confirm cancellation consequences with affected clubs
remaining_actions.summary: rvv-0027, rvv-0163 and rvv-0186 have no dedicated participation/hosting remapping; RVV/the affected clubs should be informed so the resulting participation shortfall for those teams is a known, accepted outcome rather than a surprise.

remaining_actions.title: 116 unresolved participation shortfalls and 81 temporal-clustering findings remain open season-wide
remaining_actions.summary: These predate this repair (195/73 before, now 209/81) and are unrelated to the banned-date request; they remain available for ordinary finding-directed repair (season repair-options / search) in a separate pass.

remaining_actions.title: 12 unplaced-tournament-placement and 2 manual-placement findings remain open
remaining_actions.summary: Pre-existing, unrelated to this repair; unchanged in count by this batch.

limitations: This audit evaluates the current canonical export as a whole (per the standard 9-item checklist), not only the banned-date repair; the large pre-existing participation/clustering finding counts are not newly introduced by this change and were intentionally left untouched to keep this repair scoped to the operator's global-date-exclusion request.
Export format consistency (Excel/CSV/ICS/HTML) was checked via the export manifest and plan_audit_summary rather than opening every generated file byte-for-byte.

Cancellations: rvv-0027 and rvv-0163 (both Frisk Asker, hosted at Askerhallen, the club's only arena) -- an exhaustive 250+-trial search found exactly one legal Askerhallen opening across 2026-10-17 to 2027-03-21 (2027-03-06 ~12:00-14:35), contested by three displaced tournaments (rvv-0027, rvv-0142, rvv-0163); only one could be placed. rvv-0186 (Jar, hosted at Jar Isforum) -- the only legal Jar Isforum date, 2027-03-06, was already required by rvv-0165, with which it genuinely shares two rosters (Jar Rod U11, Frisk Asker 2 U11); a 294-trial corrected search (the first pass had a bug that missed real duplicate-participation/arena-interval conflicts) found no alternative. These are real arena-capacity and roster-identity scarcities, not search shortcuts. No dedicated participation/hosting remapping exists for the 3 cancelled tournaments -- that is a genuine, deliberate consequence RVV/the affected clubs should be informed of. Unrelated pre-existing findings (81 temporal_clustering, 12 unplaced_tournament_placement, 5 hosting_balance_imbalance, 2 manual_placement) remain open and were intentionally left untouched, per the operator's explicit instruction to keep this repair scoped to the banned-date violations only -- no unrelated season replanning was performed.
